subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Education is never only about books.”?
options: It also shows that someone has thought about the person using it.
It is also about furniture, rules, technology, and what society expects children to become.
It was also about understanding effort, difficulty, and the people who made the week easier.
It was about how society decides what is rare in a world of easy copies.

本文沒有陳述「It was also about understanding effort, difficulty, and the people who made the week easier.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Education is never only about books. It is also about furniture, rules, technology, and what society expects children to become.」，答案為「It is also about furniture, rules, technology, and what society expects children to become.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It is also about furniture, rules, technology, and what society expects children to become.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
